structured_output.title: New opt-in flag for copying Ingress/Gateway annotations; not used here
structured_output.content: The change adds an optional controller flag, `--extra-certificate-annotations`, which copies chosen annotation keys from an Ingress or Gateway to the resulting Certificate. The release note describes it only as a new option, so nothing changes unless an operator sets it. The environment's values keys (global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole, prometheus.servicemonitor.enabled, prometheus.servicemonitor.targetPort, replicaCount) show no controller extra-args setting. Its manifests use only apps/v1 Deployment and cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate, with no Ingress or Gateway-driven certificate creation shown.
